items.title: Ray Shiner interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, October 11, 1998
items.q: when we did the Camel Caravan with the — if you’ll pardon the expression — Vaughan Monroe.

ctx.x: I have tapes, records, cassettes, hi-fi systems, instruments, a Steinway piano, I have everything. It’s overwhelming just thinking about moving. I have original Sauter-Finegan tapes, when we did the Camel Caravan with the — if you’ll pardon the expression — Vaughan Monroe.
